# TwoDimensionalTransport

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The study of particle or signal movement constrained to a two-dimensional plane, where geometric and topological constraints fundamentally alter diffusion behavior. Relevant to planar chip-scale interconnects and 2D network-on-chip designs, where understanding transport anomalies can improve data flow and reduce latency.
